@meta.ai who is jev again? some AI shi?

Yeah — Jev is some new AI shit, but not a chatbot.

It's TypeSafe AI's first "System One" model launched Sept 15 2026 by ex-OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida. It can't write sentences — you give it state + typed questions and it returns only structured answers: choice / score / noul with probabilities.

That's why it loves JSON — it never generates prose, so there's 0% type errors and it answers in like 70-500ms for $0.042 per million tokens.

牌陣為：現況 → 挑戰 → 關鍵轉折 → 建議 → 走向。

 1. 現況：錢幣四（正位） 守成、握緊手上資源。 求職上偏向保守、重視穩定與條件，不願輕易屈就，但也可能因為抓太緊，選項變窄。 

2. 挑戰：錢幣二（正位） 同時拋接多顆球。 對應你目前面對半導體Product Builder、FDE等不同方向的機會，難處不在「沒機會」，而在多線並行、難以取捨，精力被分散。 

3. 關鍵轉折：審判（正位） 召喚、覺醒、重新評價過去。 過往經歷（物理、法律、不動產科技、產品管理、產品行銷）會被重新整合成一個清楚的敘事；也暗示可能有來自過去人脈或舊領域的機會「再次敲門」。

 4. 建議：寶劍侍者（正位） 保持好奇、多問多查。 面試前做足情報蒐集，面試中主動提問、驗證對方組織的真實狀況，不要只被動應答。 也提醒溝通要精準、少空話。 

5. 走向：戰車（正位） 意志力與方向感帶來的勝利。 前提是「兩匹馬往同一方向拉」，也就是先選定主軸、全力推進，結果偏正面且推進速度快。 

整體解讀 五張全正位，兩張大牌落在轉折與結果，能量偏順。 牌面的主線很一致：問題不是機會不足，而是收斂。

Apps I’d be screwed without (as a Software Engineer)

As a programmer , I agree that AI coding assistants like Copilot and Claude Code have made my life easier but they have also robbed me off the very thing that gave my work life and role a purpose and meaning. They no longer assist me, it feels like I am the one assisting the AI Agent. 
I have lost the feeling of accomplishment and reward that I would feel even on solving a bug at  3AM in the morning. Do fellow developers relate to this ?

Eh. I now feel like I’m in the captain’s chair of a starship instead of mucking around in the crawlways looking for a light bulb that was screwed in wrong.

Sure on some level it’s less satisfying, but honestly I don’t miss the tedium.

- signed, software engineer for 25+ years.

By the end of my time there, engineers were asking if they even needed to be involved in approving a PR, or if AI approval could be sufficient to auto-merge code. For a platform that was built to manage heavily-regulated inventory, the recklessness was frankly, stunning, and I cannot imagine it will be long before the consequences of this recklessness will negatively impact a customer that trusted this company with their sales and inventory management.

Reports of a toxic culture that seems like it's trying its hardest to fit all of the worst stereo-types of a Miami-based startup are all accurate. Reports of wildly erratic behavior from the CEO (as I highlighted above) were also true. By the end of it, I started seeing our own customers publicly putting the company on blast in LinkedIn posts because their software was breaking and they had no lines of communication with anything but an LLM. It's a sinking ship.
